title: Abyssals v0.90.11 — Clear roads to Marasen
notes: Fixes the Marasen caravan arrival inside the canal and moves its hub to a connected road. Corrects Walter’s emergency return point and safely places travel arrivals; existing blocked saves recover on resume. Progress-aware route messages and Journal name the exact next person, tablet, mechanism or challenge and its location, including Darius’s mandatory evacuation route and Khalid’s civic prerequisites. Removes duplicate Darius access, locked optional return shortcuts and the unneeded Rapids-to-Bridges exit. Remaining road and district transitions have visible stone arches or tunnel mouths using existing artwork, and city building labels are decluttered. Preserves saves, quest progress, unique encounters, permanent deaths, package and original signing key. Navigation, quest regression and live Chromium checks run before the signed GitHub Actions release. No physical-phone installation test claimed.
